title: DeepSeek 4 Flash local inference engine for Metal
summary: A lightweight local inference engine by Salvatore Sanfilippo (creator of Redis) that runs DeepSeek models locally on Apple hardware using Metal GPU framework, enabling private and offline AI inference on Mac computers without cloud dependency.
problem_solved: Enables users to run DeepSeek language models locally on Mac with Metal GPU acceleration, removing dependency on cloud services.
why_valuable: Provides privacy-focused, offline-capable AI inference with good performance by leveraging Apple Silicon's unified memory architecture and Metal GPU compute.
